headline: Resurgent Falcons score 80 points in two-game winning streak
summary: The 2-2 Falcons had a combined 16 points, the lowest total in the NFL, through two weeks, but after a 45-24 victory over the rival New Orleans Saints on "Monday Night Football," Atlanta now has a league-high 80 combined points in a two-game winning surge.

headline: Bijan Robinson powers Falcons past Saints 45-24 on the 20th anniversary of the Superdome's reopening
summary: — Bijan Robinson ensured there would be no punt to block this time — and the Atlanta Falcons were off and running.

headline: Bears To Start QB Tyson Bagent In Week 5
summary: Caleb Williams will miss a third straight game. The Bears switched from Case Keenum to Tyson Bagent in terms of his replacement, but another swap on the depth chart will not be coming this week. headline: Cardinals LT Paris Johnson out for season after tearing biceps
summary: Cardinals starting left tackle Paris Johnson Jr. is out for the season after tearing his left biceps in a 36-24 loss to the New York Giants on Sunday.

headline: Marcus Davenport will retire from football
summary: Veteran pass rusher Marcus Davenport didn't request his release from the Bears' practice squad so that he could sign with another team's practice squad.

headline: Sources: Eagles RB Bigsby headed to IR, Barkley week-to-week
summary: Eagles running back Tank Bigsby sustained a core muscle injury Sunday that requires surgery, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
